description:
After a devastating plague claims the life of her husband, Lysander, Baroness Sharin is left a widow at just twenty-four. Unable to overcome her grief, she spends her days by his grave—until the night his voice calls out to her. Lysander returns, claiming to be her husband reborn, inhabiting the body of her long-lost first love. As familiar affection collides with an unsettling new reality, Sharin is torn between past regret, resurrected devotion, and the man who arrives too late to reclaim her heart. Caught between his beloved soul and his borrowed body, she must face where desire, love, and fate will ultimately lead.
